name: Berente (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Berente: a crowned blue shield with a bunch of grapes, a yellow arm and a wavy stripe, supported by two yellow unicorns, above a scroll inscribed BERENTE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Berente arms with crown, unicorn supporters and scroll
